recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce ordinalValue wording on the core Questionnaire page; any future wording refinement should stay aligned with itemWeight guidance in the Extension Pack or SDC.
issue_request: FHIR-8356 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care request to add a Questionnaire usage note pointing to the ordinal extension and discussing use for scores.
initial_application: A historical bulk Questionnaire update, cacb4626a3, added a Questionnaires with Math section describing tabulating scores and linking the then-current ordinal/ordinal-value extensions. The commit did not name FHIR-8356 directly, but it changed the exact notes area requested by the issue.
additional_context: Later source history rationalized the ordinal extensions, and Published FHIR-24672 renamed ordinalValue to itemWeight. The current itemWeight definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack, says it used to be ordinalValue, and describes numeric score/weight use for questionnaires. The active Questionnaire build source links to that extension with [%extensions-location%]StructureDefinition-itemWeight.html.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active Questionnaire notes already include the requested guidance under Questionnaires with Math and use the current extension name/link rather than obsolete ordinalValue wording.
